user_stories.title: Add trace persistence to ln_trace (save/load to file)
acceptance_criteria: ln_trace:save/2 successfully writes trace buffer to JSON file
ln_trace:load/1 successfully reads trace from JSON file and reconstructs state
Loaded trace maintains event ordering and sequence numbers
File format is human-readable JSON for manual inspection
Error handling returns {error, Reason} on file I/O failures
Unit tests cover save/load cycle with various event types
user_stories.notes: Uses jsx:encode/1 and jsx:decode/1 which is already in dependencies (cre.app.src:11). File format is JSON list of event maps.

user_stories.title: Integrate ln_trace with OTP logger
acceptance_criteria: Each ln_trace emit/2 call also logs to OTP logger via logger:info/2
Logger messages include sequence number and event data
Logger level is configurable via ln_trace:set_logger_level/1
Logging does not fail if OTP logger is not available
No duplicate events when trace level is 'none'
Unit tests verify OTP logger receives correct events
user_stories.notes: OTP logger is already used in 50+ modules. Integration is additive - does not replace existing in-memory buffer.

user_stories.title: Create ln_trace_replay module for trace verification
acceptance_criteria: ln_trace_replay:verify/2 compares two traces and returns ok or {error, diff}
ln_trace_replay:diff/2 computes missing, extra, and different events
Diff result is a map with missing, extra, and different keys
Verification is exact (all fields must match)
Unit tests cover exact match, missing events, extra events, different data
user_stories.notes: Replay execution (replay/4) is deferred - focus on verification first. Diff algorithm uses set operations on sequence numbers.

user_stories.title: Create ln_trace_adapter module for telemetry integration
acceptance_criteria: ln_trace_adapter:to_telemetry_span/1 converts event to yawl_telemetry span format
ln_trace_adapter:to_yawl_log/1 converts event to yawl_logging format
ln_trace_adapter:export_to_telemetry/2 sends trace to yawl_telemetry gen_server
ln_trace_adapter:export_to_yawl_logging/2 sends trace to yawl_logging gen_server
Data preservation through conversion (all fields survive)
Unit tests for all conversion functions
user_stories.notes: Adapters avoid breaking existing telemetry systems. Conversion is bidirectional where possible.

user_stories.title: Instrument gen_pnet:step/1 with trace logging
acceptance_criteria: gen_pnet:step/1 logs reduction step start via OTP logger
Successful steps log before_hash, after_hash, and transition name
Aborted steps log abort event
Hash values are base64-encoded for readability
Logging uses ?LOG_INFO macro from logger.hrl
No performance regression in gen_pnet benchmarks
user_stories.notes: Uses OTP logger directly to avoid architectural changes. Full ln_trace integration would require passing trace state through gen_pnet - larger refactoring deferred.

user_stories.title: Instrument wf_engine lifecycle with trace events
acceptance_criteria: wf_engine:start_case/3 logs case_started event with case_id
wf_engine:complete/5 logs workitem_completed event with wi_id and user
wf_engine failure paths log case_failed events
wf_engine cancellation paths log case_cancelled events
All lifecycle events include relevant metadata (case_id, timestamp, etc.)
Unit tests verify events are emitted for all lifecycle transitions
user_stories.notes: Instrumentation points: start_case, complete, suspend_case, resume_case, cancel_case. Uses ?LOG_INFO macro.

user_stories.title: Add application configuration for trace level
acceptance_criteria: cre.app.src includes trace_level and trace_max_events in env
ln_trace:from_config/0 reads config and creates trace buffer
Default trace_level is 'none' (zero overhead)
trace_max_events limits buffer size and triggers automatic trimming
Config changes require application restart (documented)
Manual tests verify each trace level (none/min/full) works correctly
user_stories.notes: Config values: trace_level = none | min | full, trace_max_events = non_neg_integer() | infinity. Defaults: none, infinity.

user_stories.title: Add comprehensive tests for tracing system
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for ln_trace (save/load, OTP integration, levels)
Unit tests for ln_trace_replay (verify, diff)
Unit tests for ln_trace_adapter (conversions)
Integration tests for trace export to telemetry systems
Performance benchmarks for each trace level
All tests pass with rebar3 eunit and rebar3 ct
user_stories.notes: Tests should use existing test patterns from test/ directory. Performance tests use bench_SUITE pattern.

user_stories.title: Add documentation and examples
acceptance_criteria: EDoc documentation for all new modules
Example code showing trace save/load workflow
Example code showing replay verification
Example code showing telemetry adapter usage
Configuration guide for trace levels
Migration guide for existing code
user_stories.notes: Documentation should follow existing patterns in src/ directory. Include moduledoc with examples.
